5231-6277-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

751-4927-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2811-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-2811-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5670-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-5931.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-5931.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Funeral Room and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-3899-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3899-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2393-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-2464-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
443-728-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

628-5523-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-5523-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-3723-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-3723-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-3446-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-3446-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2034-2415-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-6097.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2034-6723-6970-7730-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

647-2034-4289-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

5941-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
5941-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Wild Ricochet by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Wild Ricochet's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Wild Ricochet targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve a copy of Wild Ricochet, copying Wild Ricochet targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Repeat step 4.

2146-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1129-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Allies.
1129-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Harabaz Druid.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-4885.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

773-1409-6751.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve both Galazeth Prismari triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4038-4734-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Cradle Clearcutter's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

1987-4276-4823-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-4823-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Timeless Witness.
When Donnie & April and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4823-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

372-3556-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3556-6991.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

821-2173-4063-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1350-2511-2793-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-2511-3263-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

628-5256-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-5256-6863--133.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
628-5256-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

2011-4447-6704.easyPrerequisites:
RMS Titanic is a creature or other creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
An opponent cannot block RMS Titanic.
2011-4447-6704.description:
If needed, activate RMS Titanic's crew ability by tapping any number of creatures with power 3 or greater,  causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Assault Suit's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to RMS Titanic.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using RMS Titanic, triggering its ability, causing you to not sacrifice it due to Assault Suit and create nine Treasure tokens.
Before the combat phase ends, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
2011-4447-6704.notes: If you control a Warrior that can attack, you may attack with it alongside RMS Titanic to get infinite creature tokens using Najeela.

1580-3967-4871-5334.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

5231-5394-6291.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

618-2744-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
618-2744-4613.description:
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

3489-3542-3960.notablePrerequisites:
Walker of Secret Ways does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
3489-3542-3960.description:
Declare Walker of Secret Ways as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Walker of Secret Ways from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Walker of Secret Ways's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Walker of Secret Ways onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1770-2226-4518.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1770-2226-4518.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-4518.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

803-1219-1409-4221-4438.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Beledros.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1219-1409-4221-4438.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Beledros by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Beledros enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1698-2577-3260-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
1698-2577-3260-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing target player to mill cards equal to its power.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B} or 2 life due to K'rrik.
K'rrik triggers, as well as each creature you control's extort ability.
Resolve the first K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay {W/B} or 2 life due to K'rrik, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1765-3000-4050-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Squirrel and Spirit tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk' second ability by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2399-4487-4809.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Shifting Wall.
2034-2399-4487-4809.description:
Sacrifice Shifting Wall to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder for {1}.
Sacrifice Phyrexian Marauder to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shifting Wall for {1}.
Repeat.
